text: oh actually, if i just put in a seat model, it shouldnt matter huh, it would be sitting over it
resolution: User realized that placing a seat model in the cab would sit over the hollow recess they were about to solidify, so it wouldn't matter visually, and asked for confirmation. Affirmed — no code changed. Confirmed the instinct is correct and is the leaner choice than solidifying every interior face: an opaque seat/dash occupying the cab volume occludes the void, and there's no need to seal a shell you can't see behind. Gave two practical caveats: (1) occlusion is sightline-dependent, not just volume — check the actual view through the windshield/windows a player uses, since an angle that slips past the seat will still show the hollow; (2) the cab FLOOR is still worth a one-shot Create-face since a narrow/pedestal seat base may not cover a downward sightline to the open underbody, and it's cheap insurance. Concluded the back-wall recess specifically can be left hollow if a seatback sits in front of it.
